evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Under one fault on two hundred benchmark tasks across three configurations, the single-process reference lost every session and scored 1.5 percent on the official validator, the MCP configuration kept its sessions while spending 1099 calls on a dead endpoint, and Logos kept every session alive, wasted zero calls, and succeeded on 120 tasks against 102 for both configurations combined.
